articles.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
articles.summary: Pope Leo had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican said.

articles.title: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
articles.summary: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

articles.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
articles.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".
